title: Exact Accepted Bottom Interface Exchange Result Warning-Hygiene Remediation Architecture Audit

remediation_finding.description: Two pre-existing REAL equality predicates had been rewritten as paired ordered comparisons only to silence -Wcompare-reals under global -Werror. R1 restores the exact canonical equality predicates and isolates that pre-existing warning class in the qualification harness rather than changing production semantics.
